content.text:
I raised `CARRIER_TIMEOUT_MS` in `lib/carrier.js` from `10_000` to `30_000`. All 30 tests pass.

This doesn't fully fix the duplicate labels. `withRetry` in `lib/retry.js` retries up to 5 times on any failure, including a timeout. If the carrier ever takes longer than 30 seconds, the request will still time out and retry, and that retry can buy a second label. The new timeout leaves headroom over the 20-second peak, but it doesn't remove the cause.

A sturdier fix would be one of these:
- Don't retry label purchases after a timeout, since the outcome is unknown.
- Send an idempotency key with the label request, if the carrier supports one.
- Check whether a label already exists before retrying.

I didn't change any of these, since you only asked for the timeout. I can look into one if you want.
